purpose: Identify Chinese scholarship and practice-facing commentary on corporate roles in public international law that English-language discovery may miss.
local_vocabulary: 跨国公司 国际法主体资格
access_assumptions: Institutional access may expose subscription full text.
Unavailable full text must be reported separately from review extent.
authority_relationship: Chinese scholarship is searched as an independent analytical tradition; official Chinese treaty texts are authoritative only when the relevant institution or treaty regime designates them as authentic.
remaining_gap: Not assessed before the branch is run.
